newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Casualty Q4 combined ratio steady.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Casualty Q4 combined ratio steady.

text.p: Ohio Casualty Corp said the combined ratio for its property-casualty operations held steady in the fourth quarter at 98.6 percent, the same as a year ago.
Net written premiums were $291.8 million in the fourth quarter, up 1.1 percent from fourth quarter premiums last year.
Catastrophe losses for the quarter were $8.6 million or 2.8 points on the combined ratio. This compares with $4.8 million or 1.6 points for the three months ended December 31, 1995.
The combined ratio for 1996 was 109.5 percent compared with 104.0 percent for last year.
Net written premiums for the year declined slightly to $1.2 billion from $1.3 billion in 1995.
Catastrophe losses for the year amounted to $62.2 million or 5.1 points on the combined ratio compared with $27.3 million or 2.2 points in 1995.
